eps.o: Balancing parenthood with the WWE, Seth Rollins kicks off his SummerSlam arc and Becky Lynch returns to WrestleMania. Pat McAfee drops the mic to fight.
Beloved Superstar R-Truth faces a harsh reality as a contract dispute casts doubt on his career. Naomi eyes a comeback — and enters her heel era.
Penta dazzles the crowd during his Money in the Bank debut. Seth Rollins and Paul Heyman open doors for the next generation of WWE Superstars.
Triple H and the writers devise a top-secret SummerSlam reveal. An electrifying match between Iyo Sky and Rhea Ripley pushes Evolution to new heights.
Seth Rollins shocks the WWE Universe, Becky Lynch and Lyra Valkyria roll with the punches, and John Cena wrestles in his final SummerSlam match.
